summary: The frozen diagnostics support numerical-relaxation claims with appropriately bounded provenance. They do not represent enumerated set families, and the manuscript does not infer realizability or optimality from their maximizing degree tuples. Snapshot and manuscript hashes match the inspected bytes.

checks.scope: Provenance and semantic scope of exact-grid diagnostics
checks.method: Read F18, F19, and F26, verified each artifact digest against the snapshot, and compared their scope fields and reported quantities with the manuscript.
checks.observation: F18 records 6,031 admissible quadruples and maximum 4,475; F19 records 1,204 triples and maximum 2,250. F26 labels its budget-59 maximum 4,553 as sensitivity of a necessary numerical relaxation. These are local diagnostic records, not external prior-art results or family-realizability certificates. The manuscript correctly says budget 59 fails to certify support 52 and establishes neither a family nor optimality of 53. This round checks provenance and attribution, not an independent rerun of all maxima.
